title: Exploring Novel Drug Research Area using Large Language Models Based on Research Trends in Biomedical Literature

live_model.evidence: Sec 5.1: "We employed GPT-5-2025-08-07 (OpenAI) ... as the primary model in our pipeline", used for PICO extraction, entity normalization, and P-I combination identification

prompt.location: Appendix D ("Baseline Prompt": full JSON-output instruction template with {disease_labels}/{drug_labels}/{abstracts} placeholders)

claim.location: Table 2 lists example top-ranked P-I combinations; Sec 8 Limitations: "in the evaluation framework, we only used qualitative methods"

data.source: 2,262 filtered PubMed cancer abstracts (from an initial pool of 5,000); disease/drug label lists in Appendix E/F

notes: n=51 diseases x m=256 drugs (Sec 4.4) is an input-matrix dimension, not a sample count for a scored claim. Composite impact scores (0-100) are the model's own self-rated output, not validated against ground truth; the authors explicitly flag qualitative-only evaluation as a limitation.
